articles.title: Where to watch the Chargers vs 49ers game and what is the kickoff time today at SoFi Stadium?
articles.standfirst: San Francisco and Los Angeles meet in a preseason matchup with plenty of roster battles to watch
articles.summary: San Francisco and Los Angeles meet in a preseason matchup with plenty of roster battles to watch
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Chargers meet at SoFi Stadium on Thursday, August 20, with both teams using their second preseason game to evaluate players ahead of the regular season.

The game is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. Pacific Time (10 p.m. ET) in Inglewood, California.

For viewers in the UK, that means a 3 a.m. BST kickoff on Friday, August 21. The matchup will be nationally televised on NFL Network, while local broadcast arrangements are also available in the teams' respective markets. The 49ers' official viewing guide confirms the broadcast and streaming information for the game.

For fans unable to attend at SoFi Stadium, NFL Network is therefore the primary national television option. Availability can vary according to television provider and market, so viewers should check their local listings before kickoff.

The Chargers enter the contest after opening their preseason with a convincing 27-7 victory over the Houston Texans .

The 49ers , meanwhile, began their exhibition schedule against the Tennessee Titans and now travel south to Los Angeles for the second of their three preseason games. San Francisco's published schedule lists Thursday's contest at SoFi Stadium for 7 p.m. PT.

What to watch when the 49ers face the Chargers

Although preseason results ultimately carry little weight, Thursday's game is important for players attempting to secure roster spots, starting positions and roles within their respective offenses and defenses.

One of the biggest storylines for San Francisco is the amount of playing time given to its starters. The 49ers are expected to use at least some of their first-team players, with quarterback Brock Purdy among the names generating interest.

However, San Francisco is also dealing with several injuries, meaning the coaching staff will have to balance evaluation with caution. The 49ers ' receiving corps could look different depending on which players are available.

The quarterback situation is naturally one of the biggest attractions for the Chargers as well. Los Angeles has Justin Herbert , but preseason games are primarily about assessing the wider roster rather than chasing victories.

Young players and those competing for depth-chart positions can receive opportunities that would be difficult to obtain during the regular season.

The matchup also follows joint practices between the two teams, giving coaches another opportunity to assess how their players respond against unfamiliar opposition.

Reports from San Francisco's side highlighted struggles in the secondary during those sessions, making Thursday's game a useful test for the revamped defense.

For the Chargers , the game represents their first preseason appearance at home in 2026. The team's official site describes the meeting with San Francisco as the opening game of its preseason home schedule at SoFi Stadium.

A late-night game for East Coast and UK viewers

The 10 p.m. ET start makes this one of the later games on Thursday's preseason schedule, while UK viewers face an overnight start.

The contest is nevertheless an intriguing opportunity to watch players competing for important roster roles before the final preseason week arrives.

The NFL's official preseason schedule places San Francisco's next exhibition game against the Las Vegas Raiders on August 27, while the Chargers will close their preseason against the Los Angeles Rams .

So, for anyone planning to watch tonight, the key information is straightforward: 49ers at Chargers , 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET at SoFi Stadium, with NFL Network carrying the national broadcast.

articles.title: Olivia Culpo shows off her baby bump and shares a special message as McCaffrey returns to the 49ers
articles.standfirst: The couple is entering a new chapter as a family.
articles.summary: The couple is entering a new chapter as a family.
articles.body:
O livia Culpo once again gave fans a glimpse into a very special chapter of her life, this time letting her pregnancy take center stage . The model shared mirror photos showing off her baby bump and accompanied one of them with a reflection on the changes her body is going through.

Olivia Culpo shows off her baby bump in two very different looks

In the first photo, Culpo appeared in a long-sleeved white dress, paired with an updo that gave her a more elegant and understated look .

In the second image, she went for something completely different: a brown two-piece with a cutout around the abdomen and a plunging neckline, while wearing her hair down.

But Olivia did not stop at the photos. She also used the moment to share a reflection that showed how she is experiencing this stage on a much more personal level .

Culpo wrote: “Growing bigger by the day and more proud of my body than ever,” making it clear that she feels especially proud of the changes she is experiencing.

The model also expressed her admiration for her body’s ability to carry and develop her children with so little time between them, describing the moment as an experience she feels deeply grateful for.

While she continues to share some moments from this journey publicly , Christian is going through an important stage of his own career.

Christian McCaffrey is back at work with the 49ers

The running back has resumed activities with the San Francisco 49ers after spending several weeks away from practice because of muscle tightness.

His return came on August 23, when he worked with his teammates again following that period on the sidelines. McCaffrey said he is feeling good and is now continuing his preparation ahead of the start of the regular season .

For San Francisco, having the running back back on the field is important news as the team enters the final stretch of its preparations , with his availability once again becoming one of the key storylines to follow.

McCaffrey remains one of the 49ers' most important offensive players, and his return gives the team another key piece as it moves toward the regular season.

articles.title: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York arrested after prostitution raid in Ohio
articles.standfirst: The San Francisco CEO pleaded no contest to two misdemeanors
articles.summary: The San Francisco CEO pleaded no contest to two misdemeanors
articles.body:
A weekend arrest involving San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York moved quickly from a serious initial allegation to a pair of misdemeanor convictions, leaving the NFL with a separate decision to make about whether discipline will follow.

York , 46, was arrested Sunday in East Palestine, Ohio, and booked into the Columbiana County Jail on suspicion of engaging in prostitution and possessing criminal tools. He was released later that day after posting $5,000 bond.

By Monday, however, the case had changed significantly. Court records cited by TMZ show prosecutors amended the prostitution-related charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct.

York then pleaded no contest to that count and to misdemeanor possession of criminal tools. That means York wasn't convicted of engaging in prostitution, despite that being the allegation attached to his original arrest.

The arrest reportedly took place at the Wheat Hill Mobile Home Community off State Route 170, with local police assisting the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force.

Jed York ordered to pay fine

York was ordered to pay $1,150 in fines and received credit for time already served in jail. One-day jail terms on each misdemeanor count, to run concurrently, were also handed down.

Authorities also ordered York ’s cellphone returned to him, while $160 seized during the case was forfeited to the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force, according to WKBN.

The 49ers hadn't immediately issued a public statement in the reports provided, while the NFL had also not confirmed whether a formal investigation had begun. ​ ​"We are aware of the matter which will be reviewed under the personal conduct policy," a league spokesperson told TMZ.

York has deep connections to Ohio. He was born and raised in Youngstown, not far from where the arrest occurred.

He became president and CEO of the 49ers in 2008, continuing a family connection with the franchise that dates back decades. His parents, John York and Denise DeBartolo York , serve as co-chairmen, while his grandfather, Edward DeBartolo Sr. , purchased the team in 1977.

NFL could still act despite amended charge

The court resolution doesn't necessarily close the matter from the league’s perspective. Owners and executives are subject to the NFL’s Personal Conduct Policy , meaning the league can review conduct independently of the outcome in criminal court.

That leaves open the possibility that York could face discipline even though the engaging-in-prostitution count was reduced before his plea. His position within the league also extends beyond San Francisco.

The 49ers list York as serving on several NFL committees involving stadiums, media operations, business ventures, fan engagement and major events.

What happens next may now depend less on Ohio prosecutors and more on how the NFL chooses to respond.
